column1: # cases for seed/omc/tests/struct-bool, run by check.sh. Fields are separated by one TAB:
# name: NAME.om in this directory.  expect: the exit status of the compiled program, worked out by
# hand from the program text (the notes in each file give the sum). Every listed form is admitted
# by the struct-field grammar and must execute; no refusal is accepted as a substitute.
# twin: "yes" when the program has a uchar twin (bool -> uchar, true -> 1, false -> 0) that the
# current compiler runs correctly and must give the same status. That is the control showing the
# expected value and the program are valid and that only the bool field is at fault. "no" when the
# program uses a bool function value or a bool local, which a uchar field cannot hold.
